builtBy: Research by hand, 2026-11-21: the players' own recruiting pages (profiles[]), one entry per soccer registry team. Hudl's public team rosters for every school's girls soccer teams, MaxPreps' claimed career pages, a SportsRecruits profile-address probe and NCSA; each page read at least twice by the pass that found it, and a sample re-read at assembly by a separate script. No roster value is enriched by hand.
notes: profiles[] only: the players' own recruiting pages, linked by the rule of field hockey's file (lib/players/rosters-schema.ts PlayerProfileSchema): the page names the player and a sport, and either names the school (with the right city where the name has namesakes) or shows the roster's class year with a hometown in the school's own area. A soccer profile names no sport; a profile in another sport does. No grade, height, number, position or coach is added by hand, and no school athletics site was swept.

2026-11-21, Hudl: the girls soccer teams of the 35 schools with a soccer roster (34 found on Hudl; Notre Dame San Jose not found; five have no girls soccer team there and nine only empty rosters): 93 team-season rosters, 1,827 member rows, matched by name to the MaxPreps rows, then each public profile read. Kept when the profile's own team list has the school's girls soccer team and its class year, when shown, is the roster's; a nickname or another spelling only when school and class year both agree. 79 matched players' profiles are private. Every kept page was read twice in separate runs that agree.
2026-11-21, MaxPreps: every varsity row's career page (634) read twice for MaxPreps' own claimed flag; a claimed page is linked as a MaxPreps profile (always the row's own careerUrl).

2026-11-21/22, SportsRecruits: a profile-address probe for all 1,338 named varsity and JV rows (5,572 addresses, 815 live pages), each live page read through the JSON the page itself loads, and every kept page read four times in separate runs that agree. 356 pages stating a class year that disagrees with the roster are not linked.

2026-11-21, NCSA: the women's soccer school pages of the schools with players, and every varsity row looked up by name (the plain address and suffixes 1 and 2; suffix 2 not tried for 202 rows whose first two addresses were missing), and 305 of the 704 JV rows (the other 399 not looked up, for time): 3,621 athlete addresses for both builds, read as served (no login). Kept when the page names the player's school with its city and a sport, and its class year, when the roster has a grade, is the roster's; a row with no grade on the school alone. Each kept page read in two loads that agree.

Roster grades that are last season's (owner decision, 2026-11-21): MaxPreps' 2026-27 rosters at several schools still show 2025-26 grades. A page refused only because its class year is exactly one year earlier than the roster's (the player a grade above what MaxPreps shows), which names the player's school, is linked, and the row records a grade conflict marked rosterBehind (the roster keeps MaxPreps' grade). 2 rows: Kayleen Shamoun (Santa Clara), Avery Schwalen (Ann Sobrato). Pages a year later, two or more years apart, or on JV-list rows are not linked.

Second reader at assembly (2026-11-21): a separate script re-read every page accepted under the stale-grade rule and a fixed random sample of 40 of the 234 other kept Hudl and SportsRecruits pages (name, class year, school), and a separate sample of 15 of the 84 kept NCSA pages (the header's name, class year, school, city and sport); every one confirmed.
Counts as written: 394 varsity profiles for 285 players at 32 schools (76 NCSA, 42 SportsRecruits, 164 Hudl, 112 claimed MaxPreps); JV profiles are in data/soccer/jv-profiles.json.
